title: Red Peony Gambler 3: The Flower Cards Game
writer: Hisakichi Ishimoto, Norifumi Suzuki, Motohiro Torii
actors: Sumiko Fuji, Ken Takakura, Kanjûrô Arashi
plot: After saving a blind child from being hit by an oncoming train the gambler known as Oryu-The Red Peony is accepted as a guest by a Yakuza boss only to become involved in a romantic dispute between two members of rival clans.
